title: Building Respectful and Harassment-free Workplaces for Teachers and Educators
what_it_is: Building Respectful and Harassment-free Workplaces for Teachers and Educators

sections.label: Teacher workload and boundaries
sections.summary: The Minister for Education raised setting clear expectations and boundaries for teachers, including right to disconnect and limiting parent communication to official channels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: At the Annual Schools Work Plan Seminar this September, the Minister for Education raised an important conversation on setting clear expectations and boundaries for teachers and educators to manage their workload, including their right to disconnect outside of school hours and limiting communication with parents to official channels such as their school email or office number.

sections.label: School-home communication protocols proposed
sections.summary: The speaker proposes each school develop transparent communication protocols, citing MOE's refreshed Guidelines for School-Home Partnership and risks of ambiguity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Unrestricted communication can lead to fatigue, stress and burnout, impairing their ability to fully focus on what matters most: teaching.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I am heartened that the Ministry of Education (MOE) has addressed this issue proactively through its refreshed Guidelines for School-Home Partnership, also known as the GSHP, which serves as a how-to guide for working together "positively, constructively, and respectfully".

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: However, I opine that any ambiguity about expectations and boundaries left open to individual interpretation can lead to unconscious encroachment into teachers and educators' personal time, as well as place the burden of setting limits on them, which can be both challenging and uncomfortable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I therefore propose for each school and educational institutions to develop and make transparent a set of communication protocols to empower teachers and educators to set clear and firm boundaries from the onset.

sections.label: Stronger punitive measures and escalation
sections.summary: Implementing stronger punitive measures and escalation processes underlines zero-tolerance, including in-school suspensions with counselling and penalties for adult offenders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Implementing stronger punitive measures and escalation processes will underline a position of zero-tolerance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: This includes in-school suspensions with counselling and reflection requirements or mandatory social-emotional learning lessons for students as well as stronger penalties and interventions for adult offenders.

sections.label: Dedicated office for harassment complaints
sections.summary: Campuses can consider working with unions to provide a dedicated office to professionally receive, handle and manage harassment complaints.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: To build a respectful and inclusive teaching and learning environment, campuses can consider working together with unions to provide a dedicated office that can professionally receive, handle and manage harassment complaints.

sections.label: Support for harassed teachers
sections.summary: Teachers can tap MOE counselling, Wellness Ambassadors and Staff Well-being funding; the speaker suggests mental health leave or Teacher Work Attachment Plus.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I am heartened that teachers and educators who require psychological support are able to tap on a host of resources including MOE's in-house professional counselling services, schools' Wellness Ambassadors and additional funding and resources for Staff Well-being Committees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I would suggest, additionally, that teachers and educators who have experienced harassment and bullying be given the option to take mental health leave from work, if needed, or in the interim, participate in the Teacher Work Attachment Plus programme to regain a sense of confidence and stability.

sections.label: Female teachers share of staff
sections.summary: Female teachers from primary school to junior college make up over 70% of teaching staff, per 2023 education statistics.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Female teachers from primary school to junior college, for example, make up over 70% of the teaching staff, according to education statistics released in 2023.

sections.label: Teacher counsellor incentive bonus scheme
sections.summary: Schools can reduce teacher counsellors' duties, and an incentive bonus scheme can validate their extra work and reduce burnout.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: While schools currently have the flexibility to reduce the teaching or committee duties of teacher counsellors to provide them with adequate time to counsel students with moderate needs, formally recognising and compensating their work via an incentive bonus scheme can help validate the extra work often expected from those in teaching roles, reducing burnout and acknowledging their full contributions.

sections.label: Tripartite framework against teacher harassment
sections.summary: The speaker suggests MOE spearhead a tripartite workgroup to create a framework defining abuse and harassment and setting protocols.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: More importantly, which I find lacking, is the strong involvement of our unions in the co-creation and development of these policies and frameworks to build a harassment-free and respectful workplace or school environment across the entire education spectrum.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I suggest that MOE can spearhead a coordinated national tripartite effort to prevent the abuse and harassment of teachers and educators, perhaps, by forming a tripartite workgroup to create a framework on building a respectful and harassment-free workplace.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: The framework can aim to provide educational institutions with: one, a common definition of abuse and harassment and, thereby, a consistent set of standards to safeguard teachers and educators; two, recommended protocols for immediate incident response, reporting and post-incident management; and three, recommended follow-up actions to be taken against perpetrators that prioritise restorative practices for students and strengthens penalties and interventions for adult offenders.

sections.label: Preventing harassment and bullying in schools
sections.summary: Clear guidelines, punitive measures, restorative practices and partnerships foster a school culture where teachers feel valued and safe.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: When we prevent harassment and bullying by enacting clear and transparent guidelines and protocols, protect teachers and educators by strengthening punitive measures, escalation processes and restorative practices and, finally, cultivate strong partnerships among ecosystem stakeholders, we foster a school culture where every teacher and educator feels valued, supported and safe.

sections.label: Empowering teachers to report abuse
sections.summary: Teachers and educators must be empowered to report abusive behaviour and harassment without fear of repercussions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Our teachers and educators must be empowered to report instances of abusive behaviour and harassment without fear of repercussions.

sections.label: Handling reported incidents seriously
sections.summary: Reported incidents will be taken seriously, treated with confidence, thoroughly investigated, and action taken against perpetrators including police reports.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Whichever route they choose, the reported incident will be taken seriously, treated with utmost confidence and thoroughly investigated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: We will not hesitate to take action against the perpetrator, including filing a police report, where necessary.

sections.label: MOE and COMPASS refresh GSHP
sections.summary: MOE and COMPASS refreshed the GSHP, and this partnership is most effective when founded on mutual trust and respect.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: This partnership is most effective when founded on mutual trust and respect.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: This year, MOE and the National Advisory on COMmunity and PArents in Support of Schools, or COMPASS, refreshed the GSHP.

sections.label: Parents misaligned expectations of teachers
sections.summary: MOE will take a firm stand against abusive, harassing or disrespectful behaviour from parents who are misaligned in their expectations of teachers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: However, once in a while, we encounter parents who are misaligned in their expectations of our teachers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: These parents are also important partners, but as I mentioned earlier regarding our stance on mistreatment, MOE will take a firm stand against any abusive, harassing or disrespectful behaviour.

sections.label: Teachers' unions and Engagement Charter
sections.summary: The Engagement Charter addresses parent-teacher interactions, emphasising expected parent conduct, mutual courtesy and respect, and union support for teachers' skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: We thank the teachers' unions for advocating a safe work environment and for their inputs to MOE's Engagement Charter.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: This new Charter specifically addresses parent-teacher interactions, placing greater emphasis on the expected conduct of parents when interacting with school staff and the importance of mutual courtesy and respect.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Through the unions' professional development and counselling support network, our teachers can enhance their skills and competencies in engaging stakeholders, including parents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: I also thank Mr Patrick Tay for his suggestion to set up a national tripartite effort to deal with abuse and harassment of teachers and educators.

sections.label: Tripartite Advisory on Workplace Harassment
sections.summary: TAFEP has put in place the Tripartite Advisory on Managing Workplace Harassment, a practical guide to prevent and manage harassment at all workplaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: TAFEP has put in place the Tripartite Advisory on Managing Workplace Harassment which serves as a practical guide to prevent and manage harassment at all workplaces.

sections.label: Support for harassment victims, uplifting teachers
sections.summary: Resources providing support to victims of workplace harassment are available to all teachers and educators, with commitment to uplifting teachers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: — which provides support to victims of workplace harassment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: These resources are available to all teachers and educators.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: With support of the school community and partnership with parents and unions, we are committed to uplifting our teachers.
